l-e-e6-b03-13.goal: Bâ aexemples mingi ti différence ti dogs na dog's ti wara na tene règle, na pekoni kaï règle na mbeni fini cas.
l-e-e6-b03-13.material: I have two dogs. / She has three cats. / The dog's bone is big. / The cat's tail is long. Wara règle na sara écrire rabbit na lege ti tâ na 'I see five ___ in the park.'

l-e-e6-b03-13.s.s1.r.c: 's a sara kua na ni ti fa possession. Apostrophe ayeke dä ape ti mingi ti oko.
l-e-e6-b03-13.s.s1.r.d: Forme s' afa nga possession. Ni afa mingi ti oko ape.
l-e-e6-b03-13.s.s1.explain: Ti mingi ti oko, zia gï s. Apostrophe a sara kua na ni ti fa 'ni ayeke ti'.
l-e-e6-b03-13.s.s2.model.0: Tongana dogs na cats, mingi ti oko a sara kua na s gï, ni la ni ayeke five rabbits.
l-e-e6-b03-13.s.s2.model.1: Ni ayeke ye ti mbeni lapin ape me ayeke alapins okou, ni la apostrophe a ye ape.

l-e-e6-b04-11.title: Règle tî virgule na gbe tî position tî clause
l-e-e6-b04-11.goal: Bâ exemples mingi tî règle tî zia virgule tongana clause tî when aga kozo, tene règle, na vérifier ni na cas nouveau.
l-e-e6-b04-11.material: Because I was late, I ran. / I ran because I was late. / Although it rained, we played. / We played although it rained. Bâ ndo so virgules ayeke na gi règle.
l-e-e6-b04-11.s.s1.prompt: Phrase wa a sû ni na gbe tî règle?
l-e-e6-b04-11.s.s1.r.a: A zia virgule na yâ tî anzo na ndo faux.
l-e-e6-b04-11.s.s1.r.b: Virgule ayeke ape na pekoni tî clause tî kozo. Na yâ tî exemples, a zia virgule tongana clause aga kozo.
l-e-e6-b04-11.s.s1.r.c: A zia virgule kozo tî clause so aga na pekoni. Exemples ayeke na ni ape.
l-e-e6-b04-11.s.s1.explain: Tongana clause so amû ndali wala temps aga na kozo tî phrase, zia virgule na pekoni ni. Tongana ni aga na pekoni, virgule ayeke ape.
l-e-e6-b04-11.s.s2.model.0: Na yâ tî exemples, virgule ayeke tongana clause tî Because wala Although aga kozo na ni ayeke ape tongana ni aga na pekoni, ndali ni When the bell rings, we line up. ayeke correct.
l-e-e6-b04-11.s.s2.model.1: A zia virgule gï tongana clause aga kozo, ndali ni phrase so ayeke na clause tî When na kozo abezoin virgule.

l-e-e6-b04-12.material: You can help. → Can you help? / We should go. → Should we go? / Mina will come. → Will Mina come? Gi règle na paires ota na sara kua na ni na 'Tom must wait.'

l-e-e6-b04-12.s.s2.model.1: Na apaires ota kue verbe ti aide atambela na kozo na ti ndo ti ni angbâ même, ni la Must Tom wait? alingbi na règle.

l-e-e6-b04-15.title: Sens so mis- asara
l-e-e6-b04-15.goal: Bâ aexemples mingi ti sens tongana a zia mis- na spell, read, na place, tene règle, na kaï ni na mbeni fini cas.
l-e-e6-b04-15.material: Misspell asara sens 'ti sara écrire na lege ti sio,' misread asara sens 'ti lire na lege ti sio,' na misplace asara sens 'ti zia na ndo ti sio.' Wara règle na sara kua na ni na use (ti sara kua na ni).
l-e-e6-b04-15.s.s1.prompt: Mot nyen asara sens 'ti sara kua na ni na lege ti sio'?
l-e-e6-b04-15.s.s1.r.a: Re- asara sens 'lisoro.' Na yâ ti aexemples, a zia mis-.
l-e-e6-b04-15.s.s1.r.c: Unuse ayeke mot ape. Na yâ ti aexemples, a zia mis-.
l-e-e6-b04-15.s.s1.r.d: Pre- asara sens 'kozo.' Na yâ ti aexemples, a zia mis-.
l-e-e6-b04-15.s.s1.explain: Ti zia mis- na kozo amû sens 'na lege ti sio.' Use asara misuse.
l-e-e6-b04-15.s.s2.model.0: Na misspell, misread, na misplace, mis- azia sens 'na lege ti sio,' ni la use asara misuse.
l-e-e6-b04-15.s.s2.model.1: Na amots ota kue mis- asara sens 'na lege ti sio,' ni la 'ti sara kua na ni na lege ti sio' ayeke misuse.

l-e-e6-b05-12.title: Règle ti sara changement ti unless na if
l-e-e6-b05-12.goal: Na yâ ti afini exemple ti changement ti phrase ti unless na phrase ti if not, wara na tene règle, na bâ règle so na mbeni fini cas.
l-e-e6-b05-12.material: Unless you study, you will fail. = If you do not study, you will fail. / Unless we leave now, we will miss the bus. = If we do not leave now, we will miss the bus. Wara règle na sara ni na 'Unless it rains, we will play.'

l-e-e6-b05-12.s.s1.r.c: A sara négatif ti mbeni phrase ti ndüzü. Na yâ ti exemple, a sara négatif ti mbage so aga na pekoni ti if.
l-e-e6-b05-12.s.s1.r.d: A changé place na sens ti 2 mbage.
l-e-e6-b05-12.s.s1.explain: unless ayeke tongana 'if ... not'. Sara négatif ti mbage so aga na pekoni ti if na zia ye ti ndüzü tongana ni ayeke.
l-e-e6-b05-12.s.s2.model.0: Na yâ ti exemple, unless aga if na not, so la Unless it rains aga If it does not rain.
l-e-e6-b05-12.s.s2.model.1: Na yâ ti 2 exemple kue a sara négatif ti mbage so aga na pekoni ti if, so la phrase so, so atene a ye ti sara jeu tongana kota fë ayeke pëpe, ayeke na sens oko.
